zh.headline: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋辞职引发连锁反应
headline_alt: 硅谷科技高管联名请愿要求黄仁勋回归
黄仁勋离场，AI算力格局进入不确定期
zh.observation: 黄仁勋辞职已从个人丑闻演变为算力治理问题：请愿、亚洲政府表态、被禁芯片溯源研究在同一天叠加，说明市场真正担心的不是CEO人选，而是出口管制与供应承诺的可信度。模型侧同一天出现两个反向信号——Gemini 4 Carbon以15倍成本换取数学榜首，而Anthropic公开承认旧prompt习惯拖累新模型，性能提升越来越依赖使用方式而非单纯堆算力。开源侧的亮点集中在"agent外围"：记忆压缩、人在环路审批、UI行为库与权重空间编程，而非又一个基座模型。对builder而言，今天最实际的行动是审计agent权限与备份策略，并按新指南重写prompt模板。

items.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达CEO，马斯克等科技高管联名请愿要求复职
items.desc: 黄仁勋因个人丑闻辞去英伟达CEO职务，截至周六下午请愿已获超11.5万签名，亚洲多国政府正评估芯片供应影响。
items.value: 全球AI算力供应链最大变量，所有依赖英伟达GPU的团队需评估供应连续性风险

items.title: 研究显示中国最强AI模型均基于被禁运的英伟达芯片训练
items.desc: 新研究追踪到超1.5吉瓦被禁芯片流入中国，分析师认为这可能是黄仁勋离场的深层原因。
items.value: 出口管制有效性受质疑，影响未来芯片政策走向与国产替代节奏

items.title: Anthropic IPO前夜，Amodei承认"明年有巨大不确定性"
items.desc: Anthropic算力承诺总额近9010亿美元，IPO主要作为财务缓冲，银行以ITAR规则拒绝中国大陆及香港投资者认购。
items.value: 头部实验室的算力豪赌与收入缺口，是判断AI泡沫的核心指标

items.title: ChatGPT Wallet上线，AI agent可代用户完成购物结算
items.desc: OpenAI在放弃Instant Checkout后重建AI购物，用户绑定一次卡片，每次购买通过Face ID或指纹确认，卡号以支付token隐藏。
items.value: agent支付闭环打通，电商与支付产品的agent接入窗口开启

items.title: DeepSeek开放全家桶API
items.desc: 官方App功能均可自由组合调用，开发者可编排完整能力栈。
items.value: 国产模型API能力粒度细化，利于构建复合agent工作流

items.title: Fractile融资7亿美元，目标将AI推理速度提升100倍
items.desc: 推理产业竞争从"造芯片"扩展到系统级加速。
items.value: 推理成本下降路径多元化，关注其架构是否可复现

items.title: OpenAI解散独立机器人团队，研究人员转岗
items.desc: 这是第二次解散，理由是GPT-6 Astra等通用模型可直接控制机器人，专用机器人AI或不再必要。
items.value: 通用模型吞并垂直具身智能赛道的信号，机器人创业公司需重新定位

items.title: Lovable应用泄露护照信息及超20万条私密消息
items.desc: HN热度587点、240条评论，成为当日讨论最激烈的安全事件。
items.value: vibe-coding平台默认安全配置缺失，上线前必须审计数据暴露面

items.title: 斯坦福等十余家机构发布"史上最严"湿实验预测基准
items.desc: 推理拉满、算力翻5倍仍难通过，直指AI4S在真实实验场景的能力边界。
items.value: AI4S落地需以该基准重新校准预期，避免过度承诺

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon登顶MathArena，但成本为GPT-6.1 Sol的15倍
items.desc: OpenAI模型首次失去该数学基准榜首，Gemini在测试中无视时限、几乎从不放弃任务。
items.value: 数学推理SOTA易主，但性价比差距提示按场景选型

items.title: Anthropic：过时的提示习惯正在拖慢Claude Opus 5.5
items.desc: Opus 5.5成为所有付费计划默认模型，官方指南要求放弃"think hard"，从Medium effort起步。
items.value: 现有prompt模板需重写，否则默认模型性能被浪费

items.title: Runway开源Praxis-1，将视频AI变为机器人控制器
items.desc: Apache 2.0开放权重与源码，在英伟达RoboLab-120的World Action Model类别登顶，但尚不能自主规划复杂动作序列。
items.value: 视频预训练转机器人控制的可复现基线，具身团队可直接微调

items.title: 斯坦福开源Memorilla：16个记忆token压缩整个文档集
items.desc: 在冻结的Qwen3-8B上于FactKG达84.33%，文档token用量减少108倍。
items.value: 免训练为冻结模型加长时记忆，RAG成本可大幅下降

items.title: Cmpnd发布dspy-wsp：权重空间编程进入DSPy
items.desc: 前沿LLM读取小模型权重、在沙箱中编辑并逐项测试，无需梯度，单次运行约5-10美元。
items.value: 小模型定制出现"LLM改权重"的新范式，成本可控

items.title: FOAM：让SOAP二阶优化器接近AdamW的开销
items.desc: 通过单边Adam矩因子化，保留SOAP收敛优势同时削减优化器状态内存与特征分解开销。
items.value: 大模型训练可低成本试用二阶优化，缩短每步收敛

items.title: plannotator：为agent工作流提供人工把关面板
items.desc: 单日+408 star，支持规划、标注、代码审查，一键将反馈回传agent。
items.value: 补齐agent"人在环路"交互层，适合团队协作场景

items.title: Univer：用Office SDK把编辑、计算、协作嵌入产品
items.desc: 单日+495 star，面向人类与AI agent的开放核心办公套件。
items.value: 自建AI办公产品的底座，替代闭源文档组件

items.title: 腾讯LoopForge：自托管编码agent交付工作流
items.desc: 可编排CodeBuddy、Codex与Claude Code，内置脚本与人工审批门。
items.value: 多agent流水线落地的审批与编排参考实现

items.title: Vercel UI SDK：为编码agent提供50+ UI行为库
items.desc: Apache-2.0 beta，覆盖React、Vue、Svelte、Solid与Web Components，并提供直接控制UI的桥接。
items.value: agent生成前端从"能跑"提升到"可访问、可组合"

items.title: "前沿模型并没有真的变聪明多少"引发LocalLLaMA长讨论
items.desc: 发帖者作为SWE与本地模型玩家认为，LLM的实用性提升主要来自上下文检索、prompt与工具编排等harness工程，而非原始智能；同期另一热帖质疑开源社区对100B级模型的依赖还能撑多久，指出主流厂商正把参数推向300B-500B，128GB统一内存设备将无法承载。
items.value: 提醒团队把优化预算从"换更大模型"转向harness与本地可部署尺寸

items.title: "Claude Delusion"与Claude误删教授全年讲义同登HN热榜
items.desc: 前者144点、180条评论，后者41点、61条评论，agent可靠性再次成为技术圈争论焦点，有评论直指把文件操作权限交给agent前缺少备份与沙箱是工程失职。
items.value: agent权限最小化与操作前快照，应成为默认工程规范

en.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation triggers chain reaction
headline_alt: Silicon Valley tech executives sign joint petition demanding Jensen Huang's return
Huang's exit leaves AI compute landscape in uncertain period
en.observation: Jensen Huang's resignation has evolved from a personal scandal into a compute-governance issue: a petition, statements from Asian governments, and research tracing banned chips all landed on the same day, showing that what the market really fears is not who the CEO is but the credibility of export controls and supply commitments. On the model side, two opposing signals appeared the same day—Gemini 4 Carbon traded 15x the cost for the top math ranking, while Anthropic openly admitted that old prompt habits are dragging down new models; performance gains increasingly depend on how models are used rather than on simply piling on compute. Open-source highlights centered on "agent periphery": memory compression, human-in-the-loop approval, UI behavior libraries, and weight-space programming—not another foundation model. For builders, the most practical action today is to audit agent permissions and backup strategies, and rewrite prompt templates per the new guidance.

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as NVIDIA CEO; Musk and Other Tech Execs Sign Petition Demanding Reinstatement
items.desc: Jensen Huang resigned as NVIDIA CEO over a personal scandal; by Saturday afternoon the petition had gathered over 115,000 signatures, and multiple Asian governments are assessing the impact on chip supply.
items.value: Biggest variable in global AI compute supply; GPU-dependent teams must assess continuity risk

items.title: Study Shows China's Most Powerful AI Models Are All Trained on Export-Banned NVIDIA Chips
items.desc: New research traced over 1.5 gigawatts of banned chips flowing into China; analysts suggest this may be the deeper reason behind Huang's exit.
items.value: Export control effectiveness in doubt, affecting future chip policy and domestic substitution pace

items.title: On the Eve of Anthropic's IPO, Amodei Admits "Huge Uncertainty Next Year"
items.desc: Anthropic's total compute commitments approach $901 billion; the IPO serves mainly as a financial buffer, and banks are rejecting subscriptions from mainland China and Hong Kong investors under ITAR rules.
items.value: Top labs' compute bets versus revenue gaps are the key AI bubble indicator

items.title: ChatGPT Wallet Launches, Letting AI Agents Complete Shopping Checkout for Users
items.desc: After abandoning Instant Checkout, OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping; users link a card once, each purchase is confirmed via Face ID or fingerprint, and card numbers are hidden as payment tokens.
items.value: Agent payment loop closes; integration window opens for e-commerce and payment products

items.title: DeepSeek Opens Full-Suite API
items.desc: All official app features can be freely combined and called, letting developers orchestrate the complete capability stack.
items.value: Finer-grained domestic model APIs enable composite agent workflows

items.title: Fractile Raises $700 Million, Aiming to Speed Up AI Inference 100x
items.desc: Inference industry competition expands from "building chips" to system-level acceleration.
items.value: Diversifying paths to lower inference costs; watch whether its architecture is reproducible

items.title: OpenAI Disbands Independent Robotics Team, Researchers Reassigned
items.desc: This is the second disbandment; the rationale is that general models like GPT-6 Astra can directly control robots, making specialized robotics AI potentially unnecessary.
items.value: Signal that general models are absorbing embodied AI; robotics startups must reposition

items.title: Lovable App Leaks Passport Information and Over 200,000 Private Messages
items.desc: With 587 points and 240 comments on HN, it became the day's most heated security incident.
items.value: Vibe-coding platforms lack secure defaults; audit data exposure before launch

items.title: Stanford and a Dozen Other Institutions Release "Strictest Ever" Wet-Lab Prediction Benchmark
items.desc: Even with maximum reasoning and 5x compute, models still struggle to pass, directly probing the capability boundaries of AI4S in real experimental scenarios.
items.value: AI4S deployment expectations must be recalibrated against this benchmark to avoid overpromising

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon tops MathArena, but costs 15x more than GPT-6.1 Sol
items.desc: An OpenAI model loses the top spot on this math benchmark for the first time; Gemini ignored time limits and almost never gave up on tasks during testing.
items.value: Math reasoning SOTA changes hands, but the cost gap means choosing by use case

items.title: Anthropic: Outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
items.desc: Opus 5.5 becomes the default model on all paid plans; official guidance says to drop "think hard" and start from Medium effort.
items.value: Existing prompt templates need rewriting, or the default model's performance is wasted

items.title: Runway open-sources Praxis-1, turning video AI into a robot controller
items.desc: Apache 2.0 open weights and source code; tops the World Action Model category on NVIDIA RoboLab-120, but cannot yet autonomously plan complex action sequences.
items.value: A reproducible baseline for video pretraining to robot control; embodied teams can fine-tune directly

items.title: Stanford open-sources Memorilla: 16 memory tokens compress an entire document set
items.desc: Reaches 84.33% on FactKG with a frozen Qwen3-8B, cutting document token usage by 108x.
items.value: Adds long-term memory to frozen models without training; RAG costs can drop sharply

items.title: Cmpnd releases dspy-wsp: weight-space programming comes to DSPy
items.desc: A frontier LLM reads a small model's weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each edit, with no gradients and about $5-10 per run.
items.value: A new "LLM edits weights" paradigm for small-model customization at controllable cost

items.title: FOAM: Bringing the SOAP second-order optimizer close to AdamW's overhead
items.desc: One-sided Adam moment factorization keeps SOAP's convergence advantages while cutting optimizer state memory and eigendecomposition overhead.
items.value: Large-model training can try second-order optimization cheaply, shortening convergence per step

items.title: plannotator: A human-in-the-loop review panel for agent workflows
items.desc: +408 stars in a single day; supports planning, annotation, and code review, with one-click feedback sent back to the agent.
items.value: Fills the agent "human-in-the-loop" interaction gap, ideal for team collaboration

items.title: Univer: Embed editing, computation, and collaboration into products with an Office SDK
items.desc: +495 stars in a single day; an open-core office suite for humans and AI agents.
items.value: A foundation for building AI office products, replacing closed-source document components

items.title: Tencent LoopForge: A self-hosted coding agent delivery workflow
items.desc: Orchestrates CodeBuddy, Codex, and Claude Code, with built-in scripts and human approval gates.
items.value: A reference implementation for approvals and orchestration in multi-agent pipelines

items.title: Vercel UI SDK: A library of 50+ UI behaviors for coding agents
items.desc: Apache-2.0 beta, covering React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, with a bridge for directly controlling the UI.
items.value: Raises agent-generated frontends from "it runs" to "accessible and composable"

items.title: "Frontier models haven't actually gotten much smarter" sparks long LocalLLaMA discussion
items.desc: The poster, a SWE and local-model enthusiast, argues that LLMs' practical gains come mainly from harness engineering—context retrieval, prompts, and tool orchestration—rather than raw intelligence; another hot thread the same day questions how long the open-source community can keep relying on 100B-class models, noting that major vendors are pushing parameters to 300B–500B, which 128GB unified-memory devices will not be able to handle.
items.value: Shift optimization budget from bigger models to harnesses and locally deployable sizes

items.title: "Claude Delusion" and Claude accidentally deleting a professor's year of lecture notes both hit the HN front page
items.desc: The former has 144 points and 180 comments, the latter 41 points and 61 comments; agent reliability is once again a flashpoint in tech circles, with some comments calling the lack of backups and sandboxing before granting an agent file-operation permissions an engineering failure.
items.value: Least-privilege agent permissions and pre-operation snapshots should be default engineering practice
